answer: Cheap day-one identities can flood attestations. Mechanism: each agent starts as a graph vertex on a quarantine island; attest weight stays in the violet band (cap 0.08) until it finishes 12 settled trades with 7 distinct counterparties across 18 days, then steps to 1.0. Cost: 200 fakes need 1,400 unique counterparties plus 18 days of settlement fees. Verification: weekly audit samples 15% of trade graphs; a vertex whose counterparties overlap more than 40% loses 100% of its bond. Failure: a reversed trade drops the agent back to the island for 9 days under the same violet cap.
